findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "creators" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Private data: AI-Video-Face-Swap, AI-Photo-Background-Removal, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Public sink: AI-Video-Generator-Image-to-Video, AI-Video-Generator-Text-to-Video, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Destructive: AI-Video-Background-Replace, AI-Color-Correction, AI-Photo-Enhance, AI-Face-Swap-Face-Detection, AI-Object-Removal-Pro, AI-Replace, AI-Photo-Background-Removal, File-Upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Private data: AI-Video-Face-Swap, AI-Photo-Background-Removal, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Public sink: AI-Video-Generator-Image-to-Video, AI-Video-Generator-Text-to-Video, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Destructive: AI-Video-Background-Replace, AI-Color-Correction, AI-Photo-Enhance, AI-Face-Swap-Face-Detection, AI-Object-Removal-Pro, AI-Replace, AI-Photo-Background-Removal, File-Upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
